test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

This is / only mistake / he has made / in the dictation.
solution:
The erroneous part is '**only mistake**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Add the before only in **option 2.**
 
• **'The' **is used to refer to specific or particular nouns.
 
• Here, adverb '**only**' specify the noun **mistake**, hence we need an article '**the**' before it.
 
• So, the correct answer is** option 2**

**The correct sentence: ***This is **the only** mistake he has made in the dictation.*
